key.name: history-size
key.summary: The number of items to save in history

key.name: clear-on-boot
key.summary: Clear clipboard history on every system reboot.

key.name: auto-paste
key.summary: Automatically paste after selecting an item
key.description: If true, selecting an item from the popup will automatically paste it at the cursor position

key.name: popup-position-mode
key.description: 0 = at mouse cursor, 1 = center of focused window

key.name: limit-popup-pages
key.summary: Limit number of pages in popup
key.description: If false, the popup shows the full clipboard history. If true, the popup is capped to popup-pages pages.

key.name: popup-pages
key.summary: Maximum number of pages in popup
key.description: Each page shows 10 items. Only applies when limit-popup-pages is true.

key.name: cache-size
key.summary: The allowed size for the cache file in MB
key.description: If the cache overflows this limit, the file will be overriden. High limit might cause slowness of shell startup.

key.name: cache-only-favorites
key.description: Contents which are not favorites are not stored and retrieved from a cache file. This can avoid writing passwords to a plaintext file, but at the cost of persistant history. Your clipboard history, except favorite items, is lost after a gnome-shell session ends or the extension is reloaded.

key.name: confirm-clear
key.summary: Show confirmation dialog on Clear History
key.description: If true, a confirmation dialog is shown when attempting to Clear History.

key.name: move-item-first
key.summary: Move items to the top of the list when selected.
key.description: If true, move items to the top of the list when it is selected.

key.name: keep-selected-on-clear
key.description: Whether to keep the currently selected entry in the clipboard after clearing the history.

key.name: enable-keybindings
key.description: If true, user can toggle the popup, clear history and toggle private mode with keyboard shortcuts.

key.name: toggle-popup
key.description: Key to toggle the cursor-positioned clipboard popup. Empty by default; set a shortcut in the extension Settings.

key.name: private-mode-binding
key.description: Key to toggle the private mode

key.name: should-cache-images
key.description: Allow caching images to disk so they survive a reboot. Otherwise they will only be temporarily saved in memory.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: A list of applications that are excluded from clipboard history.

key.name: terminal-apps
key.description: Window classes or app ids treated as terminals for auto-paste. Terminals need Ctrl+Shift+V because plain Ctrl+V isn't bound to clipboard paste there. Add your terminal here if auto-paste inserts the wrong text in it.

key.name: clear-history-on-interval
key.description: If true, clipboard history will be cleared at regular intervals.

key.name: clear-history-interval
key.summary: Interval for clearing history in minutes
key.description: The interval in minutes at which the clipboard history will be cleared.

key.name: next-history-clear
key.description: The timestamp for the next scheduled history clear.

key.name: case-sensitive-search
key.summary: Toggle case sensitive search in popup

key.name: show-shortcut-hints
key.summary: Show shortcut reminder icons in the cursor popup
key.description: If true, the footer of the cursor popup shows reminder icons for the popup-local shortcuts.

key.name: ignore-secret-mimetypes
key.description: Skip clipboard content offering a secret mimetype (x-kde-passwordManagerHint, x-gnome-passwordManagerHint with value secret, or application/x-nspasteboard-concealed-type). Password managers use these to keep secrets out of history.

key.name: local-case-sensitive
key.summary: Popup shortcut: toggle match case while searching

key.name: local-regex-search
key.summary: Popup shortcut: toggle regular expressions while searching

key.name: local-toggle-favorite
key.summary: Popup shortcut: toggle favorite on selected entry

key.name: local-favorites-view
key.summary: Popup shortcut: open favorites or go back

key.name: enable-favorites
key.summary: Enable favorites in the cursor popup
key.description: If true, entries can be marked as favorites and browsed in a dedicated favorites view inside the cursor popup.

key.name: image-preview-size
key.summary: Image thumbnail size in the popup
key.description: Maximum height in pixels of image previews shown in the cursor popup.

key.name: language
key.description: Interface language override. 'system' follows the GNOME system language. Any other value is a locale code from the shipped locale directory (e.g. 'de', 'fr_FR'). Takes effect after a restart of GNOME Shell / reopening Settings.
